strict_goal_reason: No single global D1/D2 table or fixed grouping candidate achieved >=5% held-out activation-weighted improvement or >=10% p99.9 improvement without material per-role/per-bit regressions.
codec_scope: Four-bit measurements reproduce production MQ4V2. Two/three-bit measurements are hypothetical matched-header V2 research layouts; production MQ2/MQ3 remain single-G256 formats.

environment.local: gfx1201 search, exact codec evaluation, and runtime microbenchmarks
environment.hiptrx: Qwen3.8-27B raw weights plus GGUF imatrix extraction and independent Rust proxy

headroom.interpretation: Affine grids have substantial sign-orientation headroom, but the useful orientation is block-specific and cannot be represented by one runtime-shared activation rotation.

non_global_upside.candidate: per-layer QKV D2 table optimized on every one of 204800 G256 groups in Qwen3.8 layer 45 in_proj_qkv
non_global_upside.runtime_cost: same mq_rotate_x instructions and traffic; requires a stable per-layer/domain signs2 pointer and artifact metadata
non_global_upside.verdict: Production MQ4V2 improves 6.27% on this complete layer and the cross-bit research macro improves 5.58%, but the table regresses 0.93% across other QKV layers and therefore does not satisfy the one-global-transform goal

next_research.recommended: Per-layer rotation-domain D2 tables, starting with fused in_proj_qkv, optimized on the complete deployed weight matrix and validated with teacher-student KLD.
next_research.global_kill_result: A production-MQ4V2-only robust D2 was frozen before six fresh layers were opened. Fresh activation m1 improved only 0.65%, activation-block p99.9 only 1.66%, and tail MSE regressed 0.61%; the global-table path is closed for this campaign.
next_research.runtime_design: Keep D1 global. Store one packed 256-bit D2 table per rotation domain, expand to the existing 256-f32 device buffer shape at model load, and pass stable domain pointers through existing fused/standalone rotation kernargs before graph capture. QKV shares one table; gate/up shares one; down/SwiGLU owns one.
next_research.cost: No new kernel arithmetic, launch, or sign-table traffic; about 32 bytes artifact metadata and 1 KiB expanded device memory per D2 domain. Existing MQ artifacts require versioned rotation metadata and requantization.
next_research.gfx1100_constraint: The opt-in fused_rmsnorm_mq_rotate_vecsum_sign_const kernel bakes canonical D1/D2 words. Custom domain tables must select the pointer/LDS path or compile domain-specific variants; gfx1201 and the standard pointer path retain the measured identical kernel cost.
next_research.kill_gate: Require >=5% held-out teacher-student KLD or activation m1 improvement per domain, every bit-width non-regressing, and byte-identical runtime launch/ISA contracts.
